parsedVerdict.reasoning: This module does not form one coherent unit. InMemoryTaskRepository.ts handles task persistence. CircularB.ts is a general console logger with nothing specific to repositories or tasks, so it is a separate concern placed in the repositories module. InMemoryTaskRepository creates a CircularB in its `helper` field but never calls it, so the two files have no real working link. CircularB.ts also imports InMemoryTaskRepository and never uses it. I left out the import cycle itself because import direction is handled by other tools. Inside InMemoryTaskRepository, `findByPriority(_priority)` ignores its argument and returns every task, so it does not do what its name says. The class also has no `implements` clause, so it does not follow a shared repository contract. I could not confirm that an ITaskRepository interface exists, so I put less weight on that point. Overall the module mixes an unrelated logging concern with the repository and has inconsistent abstractions, so it fails.
